C0791.title: Alert: Leaking Chipmakers' Core Supply Chain Data Abroad Constitutes a Crime Even for Minimal Profit
C0791.summary: A typical case released by the Supreme People's Procuratorate in April 2026 stated that Tian, a senior procurement manager at a Shanghai semiconductor company, accepted an engagement from an overseas institution and disclosed business information during an online call, including the company's 2022 silicon wafer procurement categories, suppliers, and procurement ratios. He illegally earned more than RMB 3,600, and the Shanghai No. 3 Intermediate People's Court convicted him in February 2025 of illegally providing trade secrets abroad, sentencing him to imprisonment and a fine. The case emphasizes that core chip supply-chain operating data can be criminally protected even when it is not a technical drawing.
